# Mohamed Sameer

> Product Manager and Independent Consultant based in Cairo, Egypt. Works across fintech, SaaS, project delivery and applied AI. Open to remote roles worldwide, with a focus on Saudi Arabia, the GCC and Egypt, and available for consulting.

Professional background, selected work and services. Updated 24 September 2026.

## Profile

10+ years across digital products, strategy and delivery in fintech, SaaS and edtech. Combines product leadership with hands-on agentic AI workflows for rapid prototyping, requirements analysis, UI/UX reviews and structured documentation. Arabic: native. English: full professional proficiency.

Independent since September 2023, full-time since March 2026. Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score and 18 projects, confirmed September 2026. Delivered 15+ international consulting projects.

## Selected work

- **Independent practice / Upwork, Product Manager and Independent Consultant (September 2023–present):** Product strategy, MVP definition, SaaS and AI-enabled product advisory, and delivery coordination for international clients. Defined embedded-finance use cases and MVP scope for a Saudi client across four delivery milestones.
- **Applied AI review:** Compared fintech merchant-app requirements with design content across 357 screens and states, producing 26 prioritised findings and 8 delivery gaps. Directs AI agents through source preparation, task decomposition, iterative review and validation against acceptance criteria.
- **SilverKey Technologies, Product Manager (September 2022–March 2026):** Owned six products under one roadmap: consumer app, merchant portal, corporate portal, mobile wallet, bill payments and digital lending. Led a cross-functional Agile team of 12+ from discovery through UAT and release. Owned lending and BNPL workflows, configurable credit eligibility and approval rules, and card, wallet, bill-payment and merchant-acquiring integrations.
- **Scicom X, Product Manager (November 2021–February 2022):** Managed a subscription content platform across web and mobile and an Arabic newsletter tool, covering subscriptions, editorial workflows, templates and retention analytics.
- **Tawasol Academy, Product Manager (April–July 2020, contract):** Validated an education content product through research and A/B testing. Launched a livestreaming service that reached millions of organic views in its first two weeks.
- **Tqweem Masr, Founding Product Manager (January 2017–December 2019):** Built the product function across authoring tools, the learning platform and administration systems. Launched a B2B schools programme generating more than $50,000 in annual revenue after its first year. Achieved 60% user growth from Q1 2018 to Q4 2018 using less than 30% of the previous year's budget.
- **AlMunif Holding, Product Management Consultant (July–September 2019):** Remote contract for a Saudi holding company spanning retail, food, logistics and distribution.
- **Cournal Agency, Digital Account Manager (May 2016–July 2018):** Managed 10+ clients remotely across Europe and the GCC, coordinating campaigns, creative delivery and performance reporting.
- **S3Geeks, Product Strategist and Executive Officer (June 2011–January 2017):** Led distributed teams and regional programmes. Executive Officer from April 2016; represented the organisation at a World Bank conference in Marseille in 2016.

## Ways to work together

- **Fractional product manager:** Ongoing support for discovery, requirements, backlog ownership, delivery coordination, stakeholder management and release planning.
